description_en: Retrieves the audio files of shared speech corpora
description_zh: 调用该接口获取共享语料的语音文件
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-share-speech-model-audio --share-task-id Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --speech-model-code-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetShareSpeechModelAudio

parameters.help_en:
The task ID of the sharing task.

You can obtain the task ID on the Shared Corpus Management page in the Voice Broadcast Service console
parameters.help_zh:
分享任务的任务ID。

您可在千里传音语音播报服务控制台的分享语料管理页面，获取任务ID
parameters.name: share_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of speech corpus identifiers for the shared corpora. You can specify up to 10 speech corpus identifiers.

You can obtain the speech corpus identifiers on the Task Details page under Shared Corpus Management in the Voice Broadcast Service console
parameters.help_zh:
共享语料的语料标识列表，最多可传入10个语料标识。

您可在千里传音语音播报服务控制台的分享语料管理下任务详情页面，获取语料标识
parameters.name: speech_model_code_list

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
